title: A report email from data
brief:
A weekly report email, built from data.

- Put this array in src/template.tsx and write one row per item with a plain function over it, not a row copied per item:
  `[{ name: "Signups", value: "1,284" }, { name: "Active teams", value: "312" }, { name: "Emails sent", value: "48,902" }]`
- Preview text: "Your Orbit numbers for the week."
- Heading: "Your week in Orbit"
- A greeting with the reader's first name, from the merge tag `first_name`: "Hi", the first name, then a comma.
- Each item on a row of its own, its name on the left and its value on the right.
- A link "See the full report" to https://orbit.dev/reports/weekly.
- Footer: "You get this email as an admin of", the team's name from the merge tag `team_name`, then a period.
- White background, 600px content.
- The plain-text version (out/email.txt) has every item and both merge tags.

email.preview: Your Orbit numbers for the week.
